preconditions.expression: all(c in {'?', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S)
preconditions.description: Every character in S must be either '?' or one of {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in A)
preconditions.description: Every character in A must be one of {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.
Lengths of S and A are within the stated bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(c in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for c in S_prime)
postconditions.description: Every character in S' must be one of {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'}.

postconditions.expression: not any((A[i] == S_prime[j] for i, j in enumerate(range(len(S_prime))) if i < len(A) and j >= i))
postconditions.description: A is not a subsequence of S'.
If no valid S' exists, output '-1'; otherwise, output a valid S' of length N.
